data.body: [P2] Preserve terminal notifications skipped by cached child replay. A child can create callback B and return its ID while the root waits on callback A. If B completes first, the resumed handler skips the completed child and suspends on A without checkpointing. B never reaches `on_operation_end`, but this acknowledgment removes its update ID and excludes it from later checkpoint deltas. After A completes, even a new checkpoint cannot deliver B's terminal notification. Ensure unvisited terminal input updates receive their notification before acknowledging the snapshot, and add a regression covering this completed-child, checkpoint-free resume.
